chunks: From it: He decreed what He created and made His decree firm, and He arranged it and made His arrangement delicate,
and He directed it to its direction, so it did not transgress the limits of its station, nor fall short of reaching its goal.
and it did not find it difficult when commanded to proceed according to His will; and how could it, when all matters emanate from His will?
The Originator of the varieties of things without the exercise of imagination that He arrived at, and without the urge of an impulse hidden in Him,
and without any experiment that He gained from the vicissitudes of time, and without a partner who assisted Him in creating the wonders of affairs,
so His creation was completed, and it bowed to His obedience, and responded to His call,
the delay of the slow one did not hinder Him, nor the patience of the excuse-finder,
so He straightened the curves of the things and fixed their limits, and He reconciled by His power their contradictory parts,
and joined the causes of their similarities, and separated them into different species in limits, quantities, properties, and shapes,
new creations whose work He perfected, and He fashioned them according to what He willed and invented them!
ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ali describe the perfection and effortless obedience of Allah's creation?
ai.summary: In the chapter of Al-Ashbaah, Imam Ali (AS) elucidates the concept of *Taqdir* (divine decree) and *Tadbir* (management), asserting that Allah’s creation is characterized by absolute precision and effortless execution, devoid of any need for deliberation, instinct, or experience. This passage underscores the doctrine of *Tawhid al-Af'al* (Oneness of Divine Action), highlighting that the universe’s diverse forms and opposing elements are harmonized solely by His will, without a partner or assistant. It serves as a foundational text in Shia theology for understanding the direct, unmediated relationship between the Creator and His creation.

en.sayed-ali-raza: [A part of the same sermon about the greatest perfection in Allāh’s creation] He has fixed limits for every thing He has created and made the limits firm, and He has fixed its working and made the working delicate.
He has fixed its direction and it does not transgress the limits of its position nor fall short of reaching the end of its aim.
It did not disobey when it was commanded to move at His will; and how could it do so when all matters are governed by His will.
He is the Producer of varieties of things without exercise of imagination, without the urge of an impulse, hidden in Him,
without (the benefit of) any experiment taken from the vicissitudes of time and without any partner who might have assisted Him in creating wonderful things.
Thus the creation was completed by His order and it bowed to His obedience and responded to His call.
The laziness of any slug or the inertness of any excuse-finder did not prevent it from doing so.
So He straightened the curves of the things and fixed their limits.
With His power He created coherence in their contradictory parts and joined together the factors of similarity.
Then He separated them in varieties which differ in limits, quantities, properties and shapes. All this is new creation. He made them firm and shaped them according as He wished and invented them.
